# dependency-readiness

For adopted quality v1 only, validate the requirements dependency inventory against
registered inbound data, external actions and consumers. Critical current-scope
facts require confirmed authority, version, granularity, full/incremental mode,
deletion/default semantics, responsible party and confirmation. Product authority
and technical validation have distinct source paths. Bind every source hash and an
inventory/source review with concrete examples. Noncritical excluded dependencies
require a scope reason. Errors: DEPENDENCY_UNCONFIRMED,
DEPENDENCY_SOURCE_CONFLICT, DEPENDENCY_BASELINE_STALE. Rechecked at story admission.
